title: international-touch-imu: analysis code for international touch match demands and stride mechanics measured with foot-mounted inertial sensors
description: Analysis code accompanying a programme of papers on the 2025 Trans-Tasman Test Series in international touch, measured with foot-mounted inertial measurement units. Release v1.0-P1 contains the script that reproduces every value reported in 'Match demands of international touch: women's and mixed Trans-Tasman test matches' (Science and Medicine in Football, submitted 2026). No data are included; the de-identified dataset is available from the author on reasonable request under the governing data-sharing agreement.
